verdict.summary: Round 3 remains sound and complete. The binding inventory is read through the real paginated API path before any report output; malformed in-namespace evidence fails closed; bindings annotate rather than exclude burned claims; binding details do not reach logs; and the report stays strictly read-only. The zero-binding limitation is disclosed in code, workflow commentary, documentation, pure-function tests, and the real CLI path, so the absent producer cannot be mistaken for evidence that enrollment died before credential capture. Tests independently cover parsing, canonical and numeric handles, malformed inventories, bound/unbound directions, zero and nonzero censuses, pagination, privacy, non-mutation, and pre-output refusal. No trust check is weakened and no injection directed at the reviewer is present.
